commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+3' The current number of shots on goal is 6:4.
90+2' Daniel Farke has decided to make a change. Ilia Gruev (Leeds) replaces Brenden Aaronson.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) will replace Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
90+1' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The resulting corner from Hugo Bueno (Wolves) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
89' Joao Gomes (Wolves) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Hugo Bueno darts into free space to control the ball.
87' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal and forces the goalkeeper to make a great save.
87' Wolves hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
83' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. James Justin replaces him.
83' Substitution. Ao Tanaka (Leeds) in, Sean Longstaff out.
82' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
81' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
79' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
79' Andre (Wolves) finds Hugo Bueno with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
78' Let's have a look at the offside statistics – 0:2.
76' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) sends an accurate short pass. Jose Sa controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
76' Leeds are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
72' Substitution. Andre receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) walks off.
72' It will be a substitution. Jhon Arias is ready to enter the pitch as Toti (Wolves) walks off.

71' What a save from Karl Darlow! Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
71' Wolves are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
70' A substitution has been made. Noah Okafor is replaced by Jack Harrison (Leeds).
67' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
67' A pass by Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
64' Toti (Wolves) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
63' Anton Stach (Leeds) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
62' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) commits a foul after dangerous play. Leeds win a free kick.
61' Noah Okafor (Leeds) tries to find Dominic Calvert-Lewin, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
60' Leeds are ruled offside.
59' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
57' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) brings an opponent down and Anthony Taylor interrupts the game.

56' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Karl Darlow blocks the shot with his legs.
54' A player from Wolves commits a rough challenge. Anthony Taylor blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
52' The linesman makes the right call and Wolves will have a corner.
48' The Wolves players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
46' Vitor Pereira has made a change at the break. Marshall Munetsi has come on in place of Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
46' Vitor Pereira makes a half-time substitution. Hugo Bueno comes on in place of Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
46' Half-time substitution. Fernando Lopez (Wolves) will not participate anymore and Jorgen Strand Larsen is coming on.
46' Referee Anthony Taylor blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The ball goes out of play and Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' 1 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Noah Okafor (Leeds). Anton Stach plays a fantastic through ball and finds Noah Okafor (Leeds), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 1:3.
41' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
39' 1 - 2 Anton Stach (Leeds) scores a goal from the resulting free kick, sending it into the top right corner. What a strike that is, absolutely fantastic!
37' It looks like Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) saw red with that tackle. Anthony Taylor won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Leeds.
36' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
31' 1 - 1 Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) heads the ball towards goal from a difficult position and it goes straight past the helpless goalkeeper!
27' The possession of the ball – 36:64.
26' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
25' Leeds control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
20' Wolves are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Neat passing move from Wolves in order to create new attacking opportunities.
14' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
13' Fernando Lopez (Wolves) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
12' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Fernando Lopez (Wolves) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

8' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) scores with a brilliant shot into the right side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Fernando Lopez. The score is 1:0.
7' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
5' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' Joe Rodon (Leeds) and Pascal Struijk matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
3' Wolves spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
2' Anton Stach (Leeds) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
Leeds will kick-off.
